name: model-router
description: Matches work to a model. Subagents are sent to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus by what the task is, with a toast saying which. A band above the prompt advises when your own prompt looks lighter or heavier than the model you are on. Rules first, so it costs no tokens; one small Haiku call only when the rules cannot tell.

heavyWords.title: Extra heavy-work words
heavyWords.description: Comma-separated words or phrases, in any language, that send work to Opus (added to the built-in English list). Example: investigar, 设计, Sicherheit.

lightWords.title: Extra light-work words
lightWords.description: Comma-separated words or phrases, in any language, that send work to Haiku.

mediumWords.title: Extra ordinary-work words
mediumWords.description: Comma-separated words or phrases, in any language, that mark ordinary building work (Sonnet).

riskyWords.title: Extra never-Haiku words
riskyWords.description: Comma-separated words or phrases, in any language, for work that must never run on Haiku (database, deploy, production).
